turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on there is and there are?
turns.tutor:
Rule: there is for one thing, there are for two or more.
Right: "There are four ducks on the lake."
Wrong: "There is four ducks on the lake." Four ducks are more than one.
I show you one: "There is a frog in the pond." One frog. So: there is.
Your turn. Complete:
"___ three windows in my room."
